meta.score_formula: score = stars_per_day x quality_multiplier, where quality_multiplier = (0.2 + 0.8 x activity_factor) x the penalty of each suspicious red flag (star_spike x 0.5, clone_cluster x 0.1 by default). activity_factor is the mean of four 0..1 signals: forks relative to 2% of stars, issues+PRs (3 = full), distinct recent commit authors beyond the first (2 extra = full), commits (10 = full). stars_per_day is measured between our own snapshots over the trailing window when possible, otherwise from the official star-history endpoint, otherwise the lifetime average; rates are never extrapolated from less than one day.
